rules: Rank active runners by frozen V3 probability, ties by ascending number; apply EV >=0.10 inclusively.
Complete verified same-operator field and quotes required; observed within 15 minutes before departure. Prediction and selection must be archived before departure.
One fixed snapshot per race; use first qualifying archived selection, never select a snapshot using results.
Record history warnings before race. Report all eligible races and clean-history cohort separately; no outcome-based exclusions.
Incomplete or conflicting history blocks any production promotion; repaired candidate requires separate validation and model identity.
Settlements require official final result AND evidenced SG total-return payout per euro from the quote operator. Never settle at captured odds; unresolved settlements stay pending.
Cancelled or changed fields explicitly flagged; operator refunds required; dead heats require actual paid reports.
Same races and unit stake for all seven strategies; report count, win frequency, turnover, net return, ROI and race-level maximum drawdown.
2026-11-15 and earlier races excluded from prospective comparison; examples only.
First 200 settled races descriptive comparison only; no claim of sufficient power or automatic best-strategy promotion. Confirm any selected rule on a separate subsequent frozen period.
Compare top1, top2, top3 and top4 on the same newly timestamped races; never backfill earlier selections as prospective after viewing outcomes.
Top4 remains the default paper SG shortlist until a distinct future holdout validates any promotion of another rank threshold.
dependencies: Broader validation of enriched histories and probability calibration remains necessary
Verified complete prestart operator quotes supplied via existing prediction request
Actual same-operator SG payouts supplied in settlement files; no automatic ZEturf collection
